documents.title: Loving County FY2025 Adopted Budget
documents.note: Total tax rate $0.46071/$100 (General Fund $0.30263 + Road & Bridge $0.09329 + Special Road & Bridge $0.06479); levied on a 2024 taxable value of $18,233,228,957. No outstanding debt. County-hosted PDFs are scanned images; the state-hosted copies (newtools.cira.state.tx.us) are text-extractable.

documents.title: Texas Comptroller Property Value Study — Loving County
documents.note: 2024 taxable value $17.97B (Comptroller) / $18.23B (county roll); minerals ~82% of the base. 2023 was $19.94B.
